reconnectCloudHelp: Return to Posnic Cloud sign-in and approve this phone in your browser. You do not need a local server address or password.
serverSignIn: Sign in again to this server
selfHostedHelp: Using the open-source edition? Connect to your own server or a nearby till. No Posnic Cloud account required.
pinTimeout: Unlock took too long. Try again, or sign in with your password to reset the PIN.
signOutHelp: Disconnect this phone and return to setup. Completed receipts remain archived on this phone. Unsynced sales and unfinished carts must be resolved first.
signOutPending: Sales or print requests are waiting to sync. Unlock or recover your PIN, connect to your shop and sync before signing out.
signOutCart: There is an unfinished or held cart. Unlock or recover your PIN, then finish or clear those carts before signing out.
signOutSyncing: Sync is running. Please try again when it finishes.
accountConnectHelp: Sign in to find your shop and authorize this phone. No server address needed.
connectLocalShop: Connect a local or Community shop
authorizeInBrowser: Approve in your browser, then return here. Matching code:
authorizationCancelled: Connection cancelled. You can sign in again.
authorizationExpired: Authorization expired or your shop is unavailable. Sign in again to retry.
accountServiceUnavailable: Account connection is not available on the server yet. You can connect a local shop below.
emptyCart: Add items to start a sale.
name: Name
trainingHelp: Practice sales stay on this device and are never uploaded.
welcome: Your shop. Ready in your pocket.
connectHelp: Sign in to your shop, or try a training sale.
deviceUnavailable: A supported provider and device must be configured on your shop server.
manualPayment: Confirm receipt in the merchant account before recording this payment.
noUpi: No active UPI account is configured for this branch.
upiUnavailable: This UPI account cannot be used for this payment.
providerRequired: This account requires provider verification. Collection is unavailable until the server adapter is configured.
unverified: Payment confirmed by staff · not verified by the bank
codeHelp: Type a code, then add the matching item.
duplicateCode: That quick code is already used.
multipleMatches: More than one item uses this code. Select the correct item.
invalidCode: Use up to six digits for the quick code.
invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount with at most two decimal places.
insufficientCash: Cash received is less than the total.
permissionDenied: Your role does not allow this action.
grantExpired: Reconnect to renew permission to sell offline.
serverUpgrade: This server needs the Mobile POS API before this app can complete sales.
invalidServer: This address did not return a compatible Posnic server.
serverRequired: Make this change on your shop server.
customerRequired: Enter a name or phone number.
cartNotEmpty: Finish or hold the current sale first.
notFound: This record is no longer available.
itemUnavailable: This item needs options that are not supported by this build.
storageUnavailable: Could not save. Keep the app open and try again.
nativeBuildRequired: This app needs its native development build for encrypted storage. Expo Go is not supported.
shopAlreadyPaired: This phone already has a shop. Existing sales must be retained.
networkError: Cannot reach the shop server. Your local data is safe.
unknownError: Could not complete this action. Please try again.
cameraPermission: Allow camera access to scan codes.
printQueued: Receipt saved for the till. It will be sent when connected.
printUnknown: Check the printer before sending another copy.
trainingReceipt: TRAINING RECEIPT — NOT A TAX INVOICE
mobileDisabled: On the desktop, open Settings → Features, enable Mobile POS for this branch and save.
supportedOnly: Only configured, supported devices are available.
httpsRequired: Use HTTPS for public servers. HTTP is allowed only for an explicitly entered local address.
printSystemHelp: Uses the phone’s installed print service. Direct Bluetooth/USB drivers require model-specific support.
clearPracticeHelp: Clear this training shop and its practice sales, then connect your own shop. Your language choice will be kept.
wifiFirst: Shop Wi-Fi connects to your paired till. If it is unavailable, sales stay on this phone until it reconnects.
searchingWifi: Looking for tills on this Wi-Fi…
wifiRequired: Connect to your shop Wi-Fi to find its server.
wifiNativeOnly: Wi-Fi search is available in the installed phone app. Enter an address in this browser preview.
wifiNotFound: No till found. Check the shop Wi-Fi and that Posnic is running, or enter your shop domain.
pairHelp: Find or enter your shop server, then enter the pairing code issued by that shop.
keepSelling: Keep taking sales. Saved sales send automatically when the server returns.
wifiHelp: Connect this phone to the same Wi-Fi as your till. Search checks nearby addresses on this network.
noServers: No server found yet. Check that the till is on and its local server is available, or enter its address.
addressHelp: Enter a shop code, hostname, IP address or full URL.
rememberHelp: Your account is remembered securely on this phone. Add a PIN after signing in.
pinHelp: Use 4–6 digits to reopen this account. The PIN stays on this phone.
pinWeak: Use 4–6 digits. Avoid repeated digits and simple sequences.
pinAttempts: Five incorrect attempts. Sign in with your password to reset the PIN.
pinMissing: No PIN is configured on this phone.
pinTrainingRecovery: Training has no server account for password recovery. Use your training PIN.
deviceSetupHelp: Choose how to scan or print. This list does not confirm that hardware is connected.
externalScannerHelp: Pair a keyboard-mode scanner in phone settings. Set its suffix to Enter. Scan products here; leave this page to stop.
invalidScan: Scan a product barcode. Payment, sign-in and card data are not accepted here.
printWorking: Till is processing the print job
printReportedDone: Till reported completion. Check the paper output.
directPrinterHelp: Android: pair a Bluetooth ESC/POS printer in Settings, or connect a USB printer-class ESC/POS printer with OTG. Test compatibility first.
printCheckPaper: Check the paper before retrying. The receipt may already have printed.
protectedData: All branch items stay on this device. Unsynced sales and unresolved printing are protected from history cleanup. Reconnect before offline access expires; your PIN does not extend it.
serverAcceptance: Synced means accepted by your shop server. Cloud confirmation is not reported by this server.
ownReceipts: Search your mobile receipts at this branch. Requires the shop server.
cashDrawerHelp: Open with the first cash receipt only. Connect a compatible drawer to the printer. Retries, reprints and test prints do not open it.
storageLow: Storage is low. Image downloads pause to leave room for sales. Free space on the phone; do not clear this app’s data while sales are waiting to sync.
cloudReceiptHelp: Confirmed by the cloud gateway for this receipt. Stock and other shop data synchronize separately.
catalogueChanged: This item changed. Refresh the catalogue and select it again.
invalidQuantity: Enter a valid quantity for this unit, up to 999.
quantityHelp: Enter the weight in the unit shown, with up to 3 decimal places.
favouritesHelp: Tap the star on an item to keep it here. Search and categories also filter favourites.
pinSetupTimeout: PIN setup took too long. Your account is still signed in. Try saving the PIN again.
chooseServerHelp: Tap Use this server beside your shop’s till.
photoIntro: Find a product from its label, or turn a paper order into a draft you can check.
photoLanguageHelp: Language support varies by device. Check pack sizes and quantities. Do not use photos to identify loose medicines.
photoLocalHelp: No upload needed. Android reads Latin-script print; iPhone language support depends on its system. Unclear handwriting may need online reading or manual entry.
photoCloudHelp: Uploads this photo to your shop's recognition service and uses its scan allowance. English handwriting only. Your shop must enable Photo and paper orders in Mobile POS settings.
photoCloudUnavailable: Online reading is not enabled or configured. Ask your owner to open Mobile POS → Photo and paper orders on the desktop.
photoLocalUnavailable: Local text reading requires an updated native app. Read online if enabled, or enter items manually.
photoReadFailed: Could not read this photo. It is saved. Retry or enter the order manually.
photoInvalid: Choose a clear JPEG or PNG photo under 5 MB.
photoNoText: No readable text found. Retake the photo with the label or writing clearly visible.
photoWorking: Reading your photo… You can return to selling; the saved photo will remain.
photoSavedHelp: Saved privately on this device for up to 7 days. Return here to retry when connected. Items are never added automatically.
photoReviewHelp: Confirm every product and quantity, or exclude the line. Catalogue prices apply. Notes and modifiers must be handled manually; they are not sent from this draft.
photoTruncated: More than 50 lines were found. Review the original and add missing items manually. This draft holds up to 50 rows.
photoAddOrder: Add reviewed items to current order
photoChooseHelp: Check the exact name, strength, edition and pack size. Suggestions are not confirmed identities.
photoImported: These reviewed items were already added. Retrying will not add another copy.
photoChanged: This draft changed. Reopen Photo tools to load the saved version.
photoReviewRequired: Confirm every included product and quantity before adding this draft.
deleteAccountRequest: Delete account or request data removal
inventoryOffline: Offline: only downloaded records are shown.
inventoryUncertain: Check the server status before retrying. Keep this draft until the result is known.
inventoryConflict: Stock changed or insufficient stock. Refresh and recount unresolved items. Applied lines stay applied.
inventoryOnlineConfirm: Stock confirmation requires a server connection.
inventoryInvalid: Check the items, quantities and reason.
inventoryLineLimit: Use at most 200 items per operation.
inventoryReviewRequired: Check the items, quantities and reason.
connectionHelp: Choose how to reach this shop. Sign in once for each connection; this phone remembers it.
connectionWrongShop: This connection belongs to another shop, branch or user. Use the same shop and account.
connectionPending: Sync pending sales and resolve print requests before switching connections.
connectionCart: Finish or clear the current and parked carts before switching connections.
